horizon.outcome: Dungeon cleared at D34 by the 12th heir (27 runs, 11 deaths); Ascension 1 offered
horizon.blindnessViolations: none known; read tools/driver.mjs header and label-matching lines (harness only, not game source)

sameDayRetelling: My 10th and 11th heirs kept dying to the Lurker Queen at D28, because the boss focus card I had added sat above healing and retreat ('drink heal at 45% under tactic boss focus'). After four heirs fell overnight I wrote 'foe: boss -> read silence' with a $39 silence scroll, put a heal row above the card and then removed the card. The next heir read the scroll, the queen went down, he set a D33 record, and with the cadence card the 12th heir killed the Mirror King and reached 'The bottom. Nothing below.'

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Mostly legible, but the editor opened below the fold (tapping 'edit' showed only a tooltip), and the tactics header read 'floor 29 <13%' while 'VS LAST RUN · D29 0->38%' sat on the same screen. 'fired in 0 of 1 runs' for attack nearest contradicted 'attack nearest 23%'.

The hunger rule showed real foreseeable trades: '-> bank: D13 75->0% · full haul 0->75% · death 50->13%'. Lapse: forge and Legacy buys were strictly ordered, and 'compare outcomes' only compared stances ('Steady worse 8/8'), never tactics.

Learned that row order beats content ('drink heal at 45% under tactic boss focus') and counters ('read silence', 'cadence'). But the replayed fixes often did the learning for me ('survives 12/12 · was 1/12').
Carried $3010 · Secured $0 into the queen. I took control and pressed return, and still lost '$3019'. Most stakes resolve off-screen or fast-forwarded, though.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Callouts 'OGRE WINDS UP', 'REFLECTED!', 'HIT DRAIN WRAITH' read well. But the speed badge jumped 1x->128x even on Normal, and watches began mid-run ('D1–10 · 95% · +$361'). Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Drain 'max hp 53->9', hunger, reflectors and the lurker swarm each changed my rules. But D1–13 replayed almost identically every run.
The final pen was recognisably mine ('foe: drain -> attack drain', 'hp<40% -> drink heal' above the card), but half of it was applied fixes, and the build stayed fighter/Guarded throughout.
Queen saga: four heirs died, then 'Found heir 9's bones', 'silence scroll · silent', 'LURKER QUEEN DOWN', 'The bottom. Nothing below.' Lapse: the early runs (D3-D13) were indistinct.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: Check-ins were bounded (3–6 min) and travel is skipped. But the 8h absence was a stall ('5 RUNS · D28 · $528', '$11290 lost' to one cause), and the whole dungeon cleared inside one day.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: The death screen gives cause, a per-tick rule trace and replayed fixes ('ORDER · drink heal at 45% under tactic boss focus'; 'hp<70% -> return survives 11/12 · reach D17 82->36%'). Lapse: the D13 headline said 'never used unknown' while the trace showed my 'retreat at 50% 100%' loop.
'Take control' (attack/descend/return) let me push for a D17 record myself. Most goals are set by the next boss, though.

Automation cadence was visible: 'PORTER HIRED', 'SCOUT HIRED · SEND auto', apprentice 'mail +1 · pack 6 · −$7200' while away, drillmaster levels. Depth went D5->D34, with tactic slot 2, classes and oath slots unlocked. Lapse: the dungeon cleared within the horizon, so the long-goal layer jumps to 'Ascension 1'.
Visual only, audio unassessed. The torch-lit town, the tattered red 'YOU DIED' banner and the 'Dungeon cleared' vista were handsome. Lapse: watch sprites at 3x zoom were often mush.

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: The 4h return was rich ('D28 · $20193 · Boss defeated Lich, Foundry Master · New choices'). The 8h return was mostly '4/5 DEATHS' to one boss, with a counter to chase ('lurker queen [counter] read silence'). The 20m return was a modest '1 RUNS D14 $323'.

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: I could name my rules in traces and reels: 'D15 · see hunger -> bank', 'retreat at 50% … 2/39', 'silence scroll · silent', 'CADENCE LURKER'. Lapse: the overnight deaths and much of the growth came from workers and packages, not from me.
